verdict.rationale: YYLO's docs show built-in checkpoints—preflight is read-only, finish only queues a candidate, and merge/land requires explicit separate validation with no auto-launched models or reviewers—implying staged human gates rather than an agent freely acting. It also offers Simple vs Advanced modes with different levels of managed merging/isolation. However there is no explicit 'autonomy level' setting an engineering-lead can configure (e.g., auto-approve thresholds, confirmation-required actions per tier); the boundaries are fixed workflow stages, not adjustable autonomy tiers. Missing for 10: an explicit configurable autonomy-level/permission setting, documentation of per-action confirmation thresholds, and evidence of lead-controlled policy enforcement.
